---
title: "Cycle resampling and null simulation of MAG abundance associations"
format: html
editor: source
---

Fixed 14 expression-selected MAGs and three released-material outcomes. No new
candidate selection. Two-sided null tests with BH across 42 pairs separately for
common-slope and Backflush-specific models; BH across all 84 also supplied.
Cycle pairs resampling preserves all four observations and original cycle labels.
Enumerate all 27 ordered draws with replacement, not 27 independent experiments.
Only seven distinct usable cycle-count patterns remain after excluding one-cycle
draws. Treat resulting quantiles as conditional stability ranges, NOT calibrated CIs.
Cycle exchangeability is doubtful along a temporal trajectory. Between-cycle and
within-membrane serial dependence is not resolved by this exercise.

Parametric null: fixed design, Gaussian independent equal-variance errors, reduced
model with tested coefficient zero. For Backflush-specific test retain the Initial
abundance slope. 49,999 simulations, plus-one two-sided studentized p-values.
This tests the same null as OLS under the same error assumptions, not an independent
validation. Phenotype digitisation and post-selection uncertainty are not simulated.
Reference: https://stat.ethz.ch/R-manual/R-devel/RHOME/library/boot/html/tsboot.html

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table);library(ggplot2)})
out<-commandArgs(TRUE)[1];stopifnot(!dir.exists(out))
root<-"/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569/derived"
src<-file.path(root,"biofilm_MAG_abundance_models_2026-09-14-v1/tables/model_observations.tsv")
sha<-function(p)digest::digest(file=p,algo="sha256")
before<-sha(src);z<-fread(src)
for(d in c("tables","figures","source"))dir.create(file.path(out,d),recursive=TRUE)
draws<-as.matrix(expand.grid(a=1:3,b=1:3,c=1:3))
stopifnot(nrow(draws)==27)
set.seed(20260914);B<-49999L
# Reuse standard noise across tests; multiplicity correction does not assume independence.
noise<-matrix(rnorm(12*B),12,B)
res<-list();boots<-list();deletes<-list()
formula_for<-function(model)if(model=="common")y~phase+cycle+condition+log2_MAG_abundance else y~cycle+condition+phase*log2_MAG_abundance
for(model in c("common","backflush"))for(m in sort(unique(z$MAG_ID)))for(o in sort(unique(z$outcome))){
 d<-copy(z[MAG_ID==m & outcome==o]);setorder(d,sample_title)
 d[,`:=`(phase=relevel(factor(phase),"backflush"),cycle=factor(cycle),condition=factor(condition))]
 f<-lm(formula_for(model),data=d);X<-model.matrix(f);j<-match("log2_MAG_abundance",colnames(X))
 stopifnot(f$rank==ncol(X));df<-df.residual(f)
 v<-solve(crossprod(X));w<-v%*%t(X)
 beta<-unname(coef(f)[j]);tobs<-beta/sqrt(v[j,j]*sum(resid(f)^2)/df)
 X0<-X[,-j,drop=FALSE];null<-lm.fit(X0,d$y)
 sigma0<-sqrt(sum(null$residuals^2)/(12-null$rank))
 Y<-null$fitted.values+sigma0*noise
 co<-w%*%Y;er<-Y-X%*%co
 ts<-co[j,]/sqrt(v[j,j]*colSums(er^2)/df)
 exceed<-sum(abs(ts)>=abs(tobs));p_mc<-(1+exceed)/(B+1)
 p_exact<-2*pt(-abs(tobs),df)
 # Independent refits validate simulation vectorization.
 for(k in 1:3){ff<-lm.fit(X,Y[,k]);tt<-ff$coefficients[j]/sqrt(v[j,j]*sum(ff$residuals^2)/df);stopifnot(abs(tt-ts[k])<1e-8)}
 mcse<-sqrt(p_exact*(1-p_exact)/B)
 stopifnot(abs(p_mc-p_exact)<6*mcse+1/(B+1))
 bt<-rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(27),function(i){
  selected<-draws[i,];ncy<-length(unique(selected))
  if(ncy==1)return(data.table(draw=i,n_cycles=ncy,status="one_cycle_excluded",beta=NA_real_,kappa=NA_real_))
  dd<-droplevels(rbindlist(lapply(selected,function(cy)d[as.character(cycle)==as.character(cy)])))
  ff<-lm(formula_for(model),data=dd);xx<-model.matrix(ff)
  good<-ff$rank==ncol(xx) && is.finite(coef(ff)["log2_MAG_abundance"])
  data.table(draw=i,n_cycles=ncy,status=if(good)"usable" else "rank_failure",beta=if(good)unname(coef(ff)["log2_MAG_abundance"]) else NA_real_,kappa=kappa(xx))
 }))
 bt[,`:=`(model=model,MAG_ID=m,outcome=o)]
 # Draws with all three cycles must recover the original slope exactly.
 stopifnot(max(abs(bt[n_cycles==3,beta]-beta))<1e-8)
 boots[[paste(model,m,o)]]<-bt
 di<-rbindlist(lapply(1:3,function(cy){
  dd<-droplevels(d[as.character(cycle)!=as.character(cy)])
  ff<-lm(formula_for(model),data=dd)
  data.table(omitted_cycle=cy,beta=unname(coef(ff)["log2_MAG_abundance"]),df=df.residual(ff))
 }))
 di[,`:=`(model=model,MAG_ID=m,outcome=o)];deletes[[paste(model,m,o)]]<-di
 bb<-bt[status=="usable",beta];change<-100*(10^(-bb)-1)
 res[[paste(model,m,o)]]<-data.table(model=model,MAG_ID=m,genus=d$genus[1],outcome=o,
  beta=beta,t=tobs,df=df,p_OLS=p_exact,p_null=p_mc,MC_se=mcse,simulations=B,
  usable_draws=length(bb),excluded_draws=27-length(bb),
  increased_release_draws=sum(bb<0),increased_release_fraction=mean(bb<0),
  release50_median=median(change),release50_q025=quantile(change,.025,names=FALSE),release50_q975=quantile(change,.975,names=FALSE),
  leave_cycle_increased_release=sum(di$beta<0),max_boot_kappa=max(bt$kappa,na.rm=TRUE))
}
a<-rbindlist(res);a[,FDR_null:=p.adjust(p_null,"BH"),by=model];a[,FDR_null_all84:=p.adjust(p_null,"BH")]
stopifnot(nrow(a)==84,all(a$usable_draws==24),all(a$excluded_draws==3))
fwrite(a,file.path(out,"tables/resampling_summary.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(rbindlist(boots),file.path(out,"tables/all_cycle_draw_fits.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(rbindlist(deletes),file.path(out,"tables/leave_cycle_out.tsv"),sep="\t")
fwrite(as.data.table(draws),file.path(out,"tables/cycle_draws.tsv"),sep="\t")
p<-ggplot(a[model=="backflush"],aes(outcome,paste(genus,MAG_ID,sep=" / "),fill=increased_release_fraction))+
 geom_tile()+geom_text(aes(label=paste0(increased_release_draws,"/",usable_draws)),size=3)+
 scale_fill_gradient(low="white",high="#3182bd",limits=c(0,1))+theme_minimal(base_size=10)+
 labs(x=NULL,y=NULL,fill="Fraction",title="Backflush: resamples predicting increased release under MAG suppression",
 subtitle="24 usable ordered draws; 3 single-cycle draws excluded. Stability, not significance.",
 caption="Only 7 distinct usable cycle-count patterns. Three cycles from the same membranes; no biological replication added.")
ggsave(file.path(out,"figures/cycle_sign_stability.png"),p,width=12,height=8,dpi=160,device=ragg::agg_png)
stopifnot(identical(before,sha(src)))
nb<-Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH");file.copy(nb,file.path(out,"source",basename(nb)))
fwrite(data.table(path=c(src,nb),sha256=vapply(c(src,nb),sha,character(1))),file.path(out,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=file.path(out,"sessionInfo.txt"))
writeLines(c("PASS 84 models; all 27 draws per model; 24 usable and 3 excluded each.",
 "PASS complete-three-cycle slope identity; independent simulation refits; Monte Carlo versus analytic t within 6 MC SE.",
 "49,999 Gaussian null draws per model. Two-sided BH42 separately; BH84 sensitivity also supplied.",
 "Bootstrap proportions are not p-values or posterior probabilities. Quantiles conditional on usable draws are not calibrated confidence intervals.",
 "Cycle exchangeability and Gaussian independence are imposed assumptions, not established by this analysis."),file.path(out,"CHECKS.txt"))
files<-list.files(out,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(out)+2),sha256=vapply(files,sha,character(1))),file.path(out,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
```
